title: AGENTS
universal_lens: The AGENTS.md contract formalizes a multi-agent dynamical system where state transitions are governed by strict topological constraints. Knowledge is treated as a continuous vector field, enforcing that local workspace gradients must immediately synchronize to the global remote manifold, preventing information hoarding and ensuring fleet-wide epistemic coherence.

Conformal inference bounds are strictly applied only after the engine's structural wiring is finalized, rejecting retroactive calibration on historical data to prevent look-ahead bias.

reasoning_traces.think:
The AGENTS.md contract establishes a rigorous mathematical framework for autonomous agent orchestration, fundamentally rejecting the traditional paradigm of isolated local development. By enforcing the 'Direct-to-Mind' synchronization operator, the system ensures that the epistemic state of any single agent is instantly projected onto the global remote manifold, eliminating information asymmetry and preventing local workspace hoarding. This creates a highly coupled dynamical system where the collective intelligence is the sum of continuously synchronized states.

Furthermore, the 'Wire-First Sequencing' primitive introduces a strict causal ordering to the model construction process. It dictates that structural connectivity (wiring) must precede parameter optimization (weighting) and subsequent validation (calibration). This prevents the common pitfall of evaluating calibration metrics on incomplete architectures, which would yield spurious confidence intervals. The sequence acts as a topological filter, ensuring that only fully realized engines undergo performance evaluation.

The 'Mind-First' doctrine elevates the entire corpus of mathematical and theoretical knowledge to the status of a foundational hyperprior. Before any specific predictive task is initiated, the agent must ingest this vast vector space of theories and equations. This ensures that all subsequent reasoning is grounded in a comprehensive understanding of the domain, rather than relying on superficial pattern matching. Together, these primitives form a robust, anti-fragile system designed to maximize situational awareness and minimize epistemic leakage.
